question: Who has written the famous novel ‘Apsara’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Suryakant Tripathi Nirala**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Suryakant Tripathi Nirala** is a renowned Hindi poet, novelist, essayist, and story-writer.
 
• He is one of the prominent figures in modern Hindi literature.
 
• Nirala is known for his free verse and his contributions to Hindi poetry and prose.
 
• His works reflect a deep understanding of human emotions and societal issues.
 
• His famous novel **'Apsara'** is a classic in Hindi literature.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Chhayavaad Movement**

 
 
• Suryakant Tripathi Nirala was a part of the Chhayavaad movement, a literary movement in Hindi literature.
 
• Chhayavaad is characterized by its romanticism and marked a significant shift in Hindi poetry.
 
• Other prominent figures of this movement include Jaishankar Prasad, Sumitranandan Pant, and Mahadevi Verma.
 
 
 
• **Other Notable Works**
 
 
• Nirala's other notable works include 'Saroj Smriti', 'Tulsidas', and 'Kukurmutta'.
 
• His poetry often dealt with themes of human suffering, social injustice, and philosophical musings.
 
 
 
• **Literary Style**
 
 
• Nirala is known for his unconventional and innovative literary style.
 
• His use of free verse in poetry was revolutionary at the time.
 
• He also experimented with different forms and genres in his prose works.
 
 
 
• **Legacy**
 
 
• Suryakant Tripathi Nirala's contributions to Hindi literature are celebrated and studied extensively.
 
• His works continue to inspire new generations of writers and poets.
 
• He is remembered as a pioneer who brought a fresh perspective to Hindi literature.
